findings.title: The FBI was hacked again, this time the breach targeted its crime database
findings.summary_md: CNN reported that the FBI was investigating an apparent breach of the National Crime Information Center, citing two people briefed on the investigation. The intrusion, discovered in recent days, was described as the second such breach in recent months. NCIC is used nationwide to share warrant and background-check information. A former FBI official quoted in the report said the main concern was not only access to sensitive information but whether hackers could compromise the accuracy of the information officers rely on. The report also recalled the September ShinyHunters attack on an FBI jobs website and a 2023 breach of a New York field office system.

findings.title: FBI investigating potential breach of its crime database
findings.summary_md: NBC News reported, citing two people briefed on the matter, that the FBI was investigating an apparent breach of its National Crime Information Center. The bureau had no comment as of Friday night, and NBC said CNN had reported the matter earlier in the evening. The report noted that NCIC connects federal, state and local authorities so law enforcement information is available nationwide. It also pointed to a September FBI investigation into a hacking group that claimed to have stolen data on agents through the bureau's job portal, and to an apparent attack disclosed Thursday on a US Department of Agriculture system used to pay farmers.
